mechanism_interpretation: The full Magentic-One Orchestrator maintains progress/loop state and controlled transfer of the next action right across multiple operational agents. Replacing it with a simple next-speaker selector removes progress tracking, loop detection and explicit direction and is reported to reduce GAIA validation performance by 31%.
why_proxy_not_direct: GAIA, AssistantBench and WebArena score broad end-task success rather than a benchmark-defined inter-S1 interference/oscillation and its attenuation. The Orchestrator ablation also removes mechanisms spanning S2 and S3.
non_claim: The raw task-success metrics and 31% ablation effect do not quantify an S2 maturity level and do not determine canonical S2=A.

mechanism_interpretation: The published MARBLE factorial campaign evaluates Squad's first-party coordination path under same-model/same-task conditions and toggles coordination independently from Squad-generated memory. The aligned rerun reports both coordination-on/no-memory versus no-Squad and coordination+memory versus memory-only contrasts.
why_proxy_not_direct: MARBLE reports broad collaborative completion, milestone and judged-quality outcomes rather than an explicit inter-S1 interference/oscillation variable and its attenuation. The controlled ablation therefore supports native Squad S2 capability evidence without becoming a direct S2 benchmark family or primary baseline.
non_claim: The reported MARBLE deltas do not quantify an S2 maturity level and do not determine canonical Squad S2=A.
